Analysis of Systems, Controls, and Legal Compliance

PHOTOS: JAXA's (Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency) free-flying robotic camera, also known as the JEM (Japanese Experiment Module) Internal Ball Camera 2, is pictured during a technology demonstration inside the Kibo laboratory module. The Internal Ball Camera 2 is being tested for its ability to autonomously maneuver and navigate aboard the International Space Station while photographing and videotaping crew activities.
